(:begin
  [:set! ?s0 [:scanner-open "AEVT"]]
  [:set! ?s1 [:scanner-open "AEVT"]]
  [:set! ?s2 [:scanner-open "VAET"]]
  [:set! ?s3 [:scanner-open "VAET"]]
  [:set! ?it_emp [:scanner-iterate-init ?s3 []]]
  (:while
    [:set! emp [:scanner-iterate-next ?it_emp]]
    (:begin
      [:scanner-push ?s3 emp]
      [:set! ?it_m [:scanner-iterate-init ?s2 []]]
      (:while
        [:set! m [:scanner-iterate-next ?it_m]]
        (:begin
          [:scanner-push ?s2 m]
          [:scanner-push ?s0 [:intern-a "estab/cnpj_completo"]]
          [:scanner-push ?s1 [:intern-a "estab/uf"]]
          [:scanner-push ?s2 [:intern-a "estab/municipio"]]
          [:scanner-push ?s3 [:intern-a "estab/empresa"]]
          [:set! ?it_e [:scanner-iterate-init ?s0 ?s1 ?s2 ?s3 []]]
          (:while
            [:set! e [:scanner-iterate-next ?it_e]]
            (:begin
              [:scanner-push ?s0 e]
              [:scanner-push ?s1 e]
              [:scanner-push ?s2 e]
              [:scanner-push ?s3 e]
              [:set! ?it_f [:scanner-iterate-init ?s0 []]]
              (:while
                [:set! f [:scanner-iterate-next ?it_f]]
                (:begin
                  [:scanner-push ?s0 f]
                  [:set! ?it_uf [:scanner-iterate-init ?s1 []]]
                  (:while
                    [:set! uf [:scanner-iterate-next ?it_uf]]
                    [:begin [:result-row [:resolve-val f]]])
                  [:scanner-pop ?s0]))
              [:scanner-pop ?s0]
              [:scanner-pop ?s1]
              [:scanner-pop ?s2]
              [:scanner-pop ?s3]))
          [:scanner-pop ?s3]
          [:scanner-pop ?s2]
          [:scanner-pop ?s1]
          [:scanner-pop ?s0]
          [:scanner-pop ?s2]))
      [:scanner-pop ?s3])))
